_meta.description: NSE-ticker -> openFDA firm-name mapping for the quarterly FDA-inspections cron (scripts/quarterly-adr-fda.sh). openFDA drug-enforcement records are keyed by firm name, NOT by ticker, so `flowtrack fda fetch` requires the firm string. Issue #176.
_meta.verification_status: VERIFIED 2026-05-29 against live openFDA (api.fda.gov/drug/enforcement.json, recalling_firm phrase search). Each `firm` below returns on-target records for the listed issuer (typically via its US subsidiary). Re-verify periodically: `flowtrack fda fetch -s <SYM> --firm "<NAME>" --limit 5`.
_meta.source_authority: Indian pharma issuers with a US-market recall footprint. Firm strings chosen to match the recalling_firm value openFDA actually indexes (often the US arm, e.g. ALKEM ships under 'Ascend Laboratories').
_meta.notes: ALKEM uses its US subsidiary 'Ascend Laboratories' (the parent name returns nothing). Excluded for having no openFDA drug-enforcement records as of 2026-05-29: IPCALAB (historic US import alert), LAURUSLABS (API/CDMO-focused), GLAND, DIVISLAB, MANKIND. Add them if/when they accrue US recalls.
